What's your return and refund policy?
One Fast Cat • AI Assistant
Here’s the return and refund policy I found for One Fast Cat:



Products purchased through onefastcat.com can be returned for a full refund within the first 90 days of purchase, provided they are still in good condition.


For Cat Exercise Wheels in the 48 contiguous U.S. states, they ask that you keep the item at least 30 days to allow time for training your cat and acclimating them to the item.


Shipping fees are not refundable.


Return shipping fees are not reimbursed.


It is the customer’s responsibility to ship the item back to One Fast Cat.


No refund can be issued if the product is not shipped back.


If a returned package is lost in transit, a refund may be available if you can provide proof the carrier scanned and accepted the label.


For international, Alaska, Hawaii, and U.S. territories orders, returns are also accepted within 90 days if the item is in good condition.


For some items, such as Cat Exercise Wheels and Giant Scratching Towers, the item must be wiped clean, disassembled, and shipped back in the original box to qualify.


Items contaminated with feces, urine, or blood cannot be returned.


If a package is refused by the recipient and returned to sender, it is treated as a standard return, and the refund is less all freight fees including original shipping fees, duties, and return shipping fees.


Personalized items that are rejected or returned to sender cannot be refunded, but can be reshipped at the customer’s expense.


Items bought through Amazon, eBay, Chewy, or other marketplaces must be returned through those channels under their policies.



For the latest full policy, the site lists: https://onefastcat.com/pages/returns
